note: Terms of the estate's interest-bearing positions, as declared. This file states only TERMS — reference index, spread, day-count convention and call conditions. Principal is never taken from here: it is read from the corresponding Balance Sheet line in gaap-ledger.json so the schedules cannot drift from the audited statement. Both sides accrue: obligations produce interest expense, interestEarningAssets produce interest income, and the income statement presents them gross with a net interest line. A balance-sheet line that appears in no list is reported as unmodelled or non-earning — never silently assumed to be either.
attestation: A null `rateIndex` means the estate has not supplied a rate basis for that position. No index is imputed in its place and no accrual is posted: the line is carried unpriced and reported as such, and every total that would depend on it is withheld. This is the same treatment a published rate receives when the source fails to answer. Do not fill a null in to make the statement foot.

dayCountConventions.ACT/360: Actual days elapsed over a 360-day year — money-market convention for overnight-indexed positions.
dayCountConventions.ACT/365: Actual days elapsed over a 365-day year — bond-basis convention for term provisions.

obligations.basis: Redeemable at par on demand; funded 1:1, so priced flat to the secured overnight rate. Offset by Stablecoin Reserve Liquidity on the asset side, which earns the same index.

Deposit reserves are payable at the overnight rate less a 25 bp administration spread. Offset by Cash & Cash Equivalents on the asset side, which earns the index flat — the spread is the estate's margin.

obligations.authority: ASC 450 / IAS 37 — provision for present obligation of uncertain timing
obligations.basis: Interest-bearing, per the estate. The rate basis has not been supplied and none is imputed: this line is carried unpriced, its accrual is withheld, and net income and the trial-balance foot are withheld with it. Supplying rateIndex, spreadBps and dayCount is the only thing that will price it.

interestEarningAssets.basis: Swept overnight at the secured overnight financing rate. Funds the Fiat Matching Deposit Reserves, which are payable at the same index less 25 bp.
The reserve backing the stablecoin obligations, earning the secured overnight rate on the same day-count as the obligation it funds.

interestEarningAssets.authority: Held to maturity at amortised cost
interestEarningAssets.basis: Short-dated paper accrued at the Treasury bill average rate on a money-market basis.
